recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. It completes the applied page move by removing stale references to the old Security Labels anchor; further core work is only needed if the Security WG later chooses a substantive redesign of the Break the Glass examples.
issue_request: FHIR-53885 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 Security WG change request about Security Labels section 6.1.1.3. It said the Break the Glass examples looked like UDAP/HTTP request examples rather than FHIR-core meta.security examples and were inconsistent with 6.1.1.1; the approved resolution was to move 6.1.1.3 to the Security Principles page and update the UDAP reference to FAST Security for Scalable Registration, Authentication, and Authorization with a non-version-specific link.
initial_application: Commit b7b0249d1f4cc7d8442639d6c728fc7c22359905 initially applied the issue by removing the Break the Glass section from source/security-labels.html and inserting it into source/security.html. Later same-PR/security-page commits, including FHIR-53719, refined the FAST Security wording and non-versioned links. The moved section was present on the current Security page, but two build-scope source references still pointed to the old security-labels.html#break-the-glass anchor.
additional_context: source/secpriv-module.html lists both Security Principles and Security Labels as current security module pages, and source/security.html now owns the break-the-glass anchor. OperationOutcome is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/operationoutcome/list-OperationOutcome-examples.xml includes the break-the-glass example, so its embedded markdown link feeds a current example. Confluence Security WG minutes reference FHIR-53885 in the 2026-03-30 block-vote evidence path, while focused Zulip searches found no issue-specific or conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/security.html so the Access Control considerations link targets security.html#break-the-glass, and updated source/operationoutcome/operationoutcome-example-break-the-glass.xml so the example description also points to the moved Security page section. No Break the Glass content was re-added to Security Labels, and no FAST Security wording was changed because the current wording already uses the proper IG name and non-version-specific links.
source_changes: source/security.html: changed the Access Control considerations Break the Glass link from security-labels.html#break-the-glass to security.html#break-the-glass.
source/operationoutcome/operationoutcome-example-break-the-glass.xml: changed the Break-The-Glass example description link from the old Security Labels anchor to security.html#break-the-glass.

related_jiras.note: Changed FAST Security guidance on source/security.html from SHOULD to MAY and retained current non-version-specific FAST Security links, so it constrains this reconciliation from changing that wording.
